motion_core_fbtypes_ComponentVersionInfo.description: version information (uses semantic versioning) of a single motion component

majorVersion.description: major version number of the motion component

minorVersion.description: minor version number of the motion component

patchVersion.description: patch version number of the motion component

buildNumber.description: build number of the motion component

branch.description: name of the branch, in which this motion component was built

commit.description: ID of the commit, that was built for the component

appName.description: name of the app, that contains the motion component

active.description: is this component active (installed, loaded and running)? This might be false for components, that were uninstalled or currently updated.
